integrity: A self-contained arithmetic descent and complete 25-state functional graph establish the infinite result; independent mathematical auditing has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only the shift 3 is classified. No formula for basin membership of arbitrary integers is claimed. An unindexed equivalent dynamical classification cannot be excluded; finite computational experiments do not prove global behavior.
title: Complete periodic-orbit classification and sharp absorbing bound for \(\varphi(n)+3\)
